summary: Tested Creative Library feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed covering auth-gating, list, filters (q/kind/client_id), delete, and the guarded save-on-success path (verified that a failed Higgsfield visual job does NOT insert a creative row). Frontend: logged in as admin, navigated via nav-dash-library, verified grid renders seeded creatives, prompt search 'roof' filters the grid, Video filter reduces/empties results, All restores. Cards show client tag, prompt, and open/copy/delete controls.

issues: Initial DOM had 3 creative-* nodes but only 2 seed items were expected (a 3rd row likely persisted from a prior test iteration). Not a code bug, but consider making seed idempotent or clearing stale creatives between runs.

action_items: Optional: make seed_creatives idempotent (upsert by id/prompt) to avoid drift across test iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: run_visual_job correctly guards creative insert behind successful media generation (inside try before except) — good.
delete_creative is idempotent (returns 200 even for non-existent id). Acceptable but could return 404 for stricter API semantics.
server.py is 955 lines — consider splitting into routers per resource (clients, ads, creatives, documents) per the >700-line guideline.
seed_data_creation: None created; used existing seeded creatives. A queued visual job with prompt 'TEST_guard_no_save_on_fail unique xyzzy' was created and ended in 'failed' status (no creative row added).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Creative Library backend + frontend integration verified. Seed appears non-idempotent; a 3rd creative row may accumulate. If future tests assert exact counts, clean db.creatives first or make seed upsert.
